title: List the part choices of a Vault component
summary: Finds a component item in the installed Vaults (workspaces) by its HRID, gets that Vault's part catalog and lists the item's part choices with part ID, MPN, manufacturer and description.
phrasings: get the manufacturer parts of a workspace component
find a component by item HRID
read approved MPNs from the part catalog
list part choices for a library component

commands.name: GetPartChoiceInfo
commands.description: List the part choices of a Vault component
commands.params: Hrid=<component item HRID, required; the menu passes CMP-00029-00000>|Vault=<index, optional; default: search all installed Vaults>
